kernel_pair.source: CIF_v2 v2.1.0 Pairing (byte-frozen, opencif/reference); Hill fit: glossary macros

P8.status: diagnostic only, not an audit and not gated (docs/LIMITATIONS.md 6): the two criteria of CIF_v2's physics auditor check P8, computed from the design (CIF_v2's auditor is not run on the exported mask; opencif's own drawn-mask checks are assessment.status.drawn_mask_assessment) at the auditor's default operating point (5 uL/min) and at the design flow; its 0.05 Re D_h is the entrance length spec v5, the glossary and CIF_v2 S16-c call wrong in this regime, and its Re limit 1.0 is CIF_v2's settable default (App. B prints no value), not the design envelope's (Re_max = 10, M14)

gates.dean_note: Dean's leading term 0.03058 (K/576)^2, K = 2 Re^2 a/R, at Re = Re_any_channel_bound and a/R = 1 (a: half-width in the plane of the bend): an order-of-magnitude screening estimate for every bend, not a validated bound (Dean's result is for a circular pipe; no per-bend a/R or 3-D solve); Re_any_channel_bound = 2 rho Q/(mu (h + F_min - 0.1 um)), every channel being at least the DRC's tested width

fluid.note: water; the Reynolds gates scale with rho/mu

cutoff_band_um.basis: on the plateau: the kappa_g interval x delta*
cutoff_band_um.method: on the plateau (u_min >= 0.035): the kappa_g interval x delta*.  Below it the record uses App. B P-C7.1 (the frozen Hill fit; glossary \hillKmax, \hillUhalf, \hillN): band [kappa(u) delta*, kappa_g delta*], plateau-anchored (App. B C7 CQ3)

refused.advice: strict mode refuses designs outside the validity envelope (App. B thesis scope: the kappa plateau and the M14 channel and Stokes gates; with them the M13 gap-dominance gate of spec v5 sec. 19). The cutoff is still predicted: cutoff band 6.767-7.234 um, on the plateau: the kappa_g interval x delta*. Build it with gates.mode: evaluate to draw and measure the mask.

notes: head width: 5600 um, the narrowest that seals gap 1 within 0.3 to 1 times the available 18000 um (+3%); 0.3 times seals already: the floor of the search

measured on the drawing: every side segment, head unit length and width, U-turn side and centre arc, outlet lead, gap opening and centre width.  Taken from the design (not measured): the post length across the flow (gap length l_g) and so the side channels' inner edge, the radii of the head and outlet arcs (their widths are measured), the head rows' centre-path lengths, and any off-chip tubing.
